notes: Build84 keeps the browser package allowlisted to one canonical launcher, one event-driven runtime client, one clean account controller and one minimal Runtime Bus. License activation, protocol-based trust attestation, GitHub App connect/status, Supabase OAuth connect/status and on-demand Lovable project snapshots are reattached without shipping the legacy ui/content stack. The Supabase trust backend accepts ld-runtime-bus/1 independent of an exact client version while preserving 2.4.21 only as a legacy compatibility path. No mount guardian, global MutationObserver, continuous polling, heavy AI/agent runtime, OTA metadata or nested ZIP is shipped.
